description: Network Model for a Smart Energy Network Digital Twin is a model or code deposit deposited in Newcastle University by its authors Matthew Deakin, Zhong Fan. This record provides the network model used for creating the Digital Twin of the Smart Energy Network Demonstrator at Keele University in the OpenDSS file format. The master file is called 'master_dsse.dss'. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 4032 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
